name: GR00T N1 2B
family: Vision-language-action model for humanoids (Eagle-2 VLM, diffusion transformer action module)

sources.title: NVIDIA, GR00T N1: An Open Foundation Model for Generalist Humanoid Robots, arXiv:2503.14734
sources.covers: the 224 × 224 input, 64 image tokens per frame, H = 16, the inference time on an L40, the 10 Hz and 120 Hz rates, cameras per benchmark

sources.title: nvidia/GR00T-N1-2B · Hugging Face (model card)
sources.covers: "Variable number of 224x224 uint8 image frames", a varying number of views, the licence

sources.title: NVIDIA/Isaac-GR00T (official code), branch n1-release, commit 755876a: gr00t/experiment/data_config.py, gr00t/data/transform/video.py
sources.covers: VideoCrop(scale=0.95) then VideoResize to 224 × 224; the centre crop in eval mode; action_indices

note: The official N1 data configurations crop each video frame to 95 % of each side (random in training, centred in eval) and then resize it to 224 × 224 without keeping the aspect ratio. The patch size of the SigLIP-2 encoder inside Eagle-2 is not stated; after pixel shuffle each frame is 64 tokens. The number of views varies by embodiment (three in RoboCasa, one egocentric camera on the GR-1 tabletop tasks). control_hz is the action module's rate (the VLM runs at 10 Hz). The model card gives the weights' licence as "Nvidia License", linking NVIDIA-OneWay-Noncommercial-License-22Mar2022 (re-read 2026-11-07); DexVantage bundles these figures only, not the model.

input_resolution.quote: "Images are encoded at resolution 224×224 followed by pixel shuffle"; model card: "Variable number of 224x224 uint8 image frames"

crop_rule.quote: VideoCrop(apply_to=self.video_keys, scale=0.95), VideoResize(apply_to=self.video_keys, height=224, width=224, interpolation="linear"); VideoCrop: "If mode is "eval", return a center crop transform."

crop_side_fraction.quote: size = (int(self.height * self.scale), int(self.width * self.scale)) with scale=0.95

patch_px.quote: Not stated (the image encoder is SigLIP-2 inside Eagle-2).

tokens_per_image.quote: "resulting in 64 image token embeddings per frame"

n_cameras.quote: Not fixed: it "handles a varying number of views per embodiment" (model card); RoboCasa uses three cameras, GR-1 tabletop one.

action_chunk.quote: "We set H=16 in our implementation." (data_config: action_indices = list(range(16)))

inference_ms.quote: "The inference time for sampling a chunk of 16 actions is 63.9ms on an L40 GPU using bf16."

control_hz.quote: the action module "generates closed-loop motor actions at a higher frequency (120Hz)"; the VLM "runs at 10Hz"
